summary: Grays Harbor County lookout cabin moved from Hobi Peak in 1946, staffed in 1957, torn down before 1970; in 2017 the land was timber company land needing a permit.

facts.design: Two-story wooden lookout house, 10 by 10 ft at the base
facts.status_note: Gone by 1963 per the register; no structure is described at the site

access.note: Willhite's 2017 note says the land was Rayonier Timberlands and needed an access permit. It is the latest owner information in the sources read.

visit.trail_note: Park at the white gate about 6.6 miles along East Humptulips Road from Highway 101. Most of the route follows a historic railroad grade (Willhite).

events.note: Moved from Hobi Peak near Artic to Brittain Hill on the Humptulips, per the 1946 Forestry Division annual report quoted by Willhite
Muriel Bodey starts her fifth year as lookout, per a June 13, 1957 Daily Chronicle item quoted by Forest Lookouts
Register says gone by 1963; a 1970 USGS party reported the lookout house torn down several years before 1970

notes_for_editor: Size conflicts: the 1946 report gives 14 by 14 feet for the tower as moved; the register and the 1953 benchmark description give 10 by 10 feet. Distance from Aberdeen: 20 miles (firelookout.com) against about 19 miles by airline (Forest Lookouts). The story gives both. The 1957 staffing item was read only as quoted on Forest Lookouts; the Daily Chronicle original was not seen. The 2017 owner note is the latest owner information found. The record's ownership is unknown and was not changed.
